video_21.raw:
1. A man is running down a street with buildings behind him.
2. The same person continues to run past some trees before turning around.
3. He then runs towards an open field where he stops near tall grass.
4. Another angle shows someone standing by cars parked along the side of the road.
5. An aerial view reveals more details about nearby houses and fields.
6. Finally, another close-up shot focuses on people walking through what appears to be a park area.
7. A man is walking down a hallway with another person following him.
8. The camera pans to show an empty room where people are standing around.
9. Inside that same building there's someone dancing near furniture.
10. In front of them stands a large concrete box-like structure.
11. A man is holding a piece of paper while standing indoors with another person nearby.
12. The same two men are now walking down an outdoor path surrounded by greenery.
13. Two more people join them as they continue their walk along the sidewalk lined with buildings.
14. They stop to talk near some parked cars before continuing further away.
15. One individual stops at a bus stop where he waits for someone else who has just arrived.
16. He then walks towards his destination after being picked up by others waiting there.
17. Finally, all four individuals stand together outside a building entrance talking amongst themselves.
